The '''V-1 Rakata freeze bomb''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]-derived [[cold grenade]] that was used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The V-1 Rakata freeze bomb appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the types of grenades usable in player-vs-player combat.
